title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Seriously Studying, Publicizing, and Implementing the Heroes and Martyrs Protection Law of the People's Republic of China
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Notice on Seriously Studying, Publicizing, and Implementing the Law of the People's Republic of China on the Protection of Heroes and Martyrs

Fa [2018] No. 118

To the High People's Courts of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Military Court of the People's Liberation Army; and the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the High People's Court of the Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region:

The Law of the People's Republic of China on the Protection of Heroes and Martyrs (hereinafter referred to as the "Heroes and Martyrs Protection Law") was adopted at the second session of the Standing Committee of the Thirteenth National People's Congress on April 27, 2018, and shall come into force on May 1, 2018. In order to correctly apply the Heroes and Martyrs Protection Law in trial work, notice is hereby given on the relevant matters as follows:

1. Fully understand the significance of implementing the Heroes and Martyrs Protection Law. The Heroes and Martyrs Protection Law is an important law enacted to strengthen the protection of heroes and martyrs, safeguard the public interest, and inherit and promote the spirit of heroes and martyrs and the spirit of patriotism. It is of great significance for cultivating and practicing the core socialist values and stimulating the powerful spiritual force necessary to realize the Chinese Dream of the great rejuvenation of the Chinese nation. We must attach great importance to, thoroughly study, and earnestly implement the relevant provisions of the Heroes and Martyrs Protection Law, use judicial means to defend the legitimate rights and interests of heroes and martyrs, uphold public order and good customs, promote core socialist values, and oppose historical nihilism.

2. Adjudicate cases involving infringement of the names, portraits, reputations, and honors of heroes and martyrs in accordance with the law. Cases brought by the close relatives of heroes and martyrs concerning infringement of their names, portraits, reputations, and honors shall be accepted in accordance with the law and relevant judicial interpretations, and the civil liability to be borne by the perpetrator, network service provider, and others shall be determined. Cases brought by the procuratorial authority concerning infringement of the names, portraits, reputations, and honors of heroes and martyrs shall be promptly accepted in accordance with the provisions of Article 55 of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China and other relevant provisions, and the civil liability to be borne by the perpetrator shall be determined in accordance with the General Provisions of the Civil Law of the People's Republic of China, the Tort Law of the People's Republic of China, the Heroes and Martyrs Protection Law, and other laws and relevant judicial interpretations.

3. Adjudicate cases involving trademark rights, copyright, and other matters related to the images and deeds of heroes and martyrs in accordance with the law. For acts that distort, vilify, desecrate, or deny the deeds and spirit of heroes and martyrs, slander or demean their images, or infringe upon copyright, the perpetrator shall be determined to bear corresponding legal liability in accordance with the law. Through judicial judgments, we must unequivocally safeguard the value identification of the general public towards the deeds of heroes and martyrs and their publicly recognized and well-known glorious images, and maximize the organic unity of the political, legal, and social effects of case judgments.

4. Adjudicate criminal cases involving the protection of heroes and martyrs in accordance with the law. Acts that infringe upon the names, portraits, reputations, or honors of heroes and martyrs, harming the public interest; acts that desecrate or deny the deeds and spirit of heroes and martyrs, advocate or glorify wars of aggression or acts of aggression, create disturbances, or disrupt public order; acts that encroach upon, damage, or deface facilities commemorating heroes and martyrs; and acts by relevant functionaries with statutory duties who abuse their powers, neglect their duties, or engage in malpractice for personal gain in the work of protecting heroes and martyrs, which constitute crimes, shall be investigated for criminal liability in accordance with the law.

5. Strengthen guidance to lower courts in implementing the Heroes and Martyrs Protection Law and adjudicating cases involving the protection of heroes and martyrs. We must earnestly organize study, publicity, and implementation, focusing on both trial work and research, promptly summarize new situations and new problems arising in trial work, and propose targeted new countermeasures. We must attach great importance to the adjudication of cases involving the protection of heroes and martyrs, as well as the guidance of public opinion and publicity work, actively strengthen communication and coordination with local party committees, relevant departments, media, and academic research institutions, effectively enhance the consciousness and creativity of judicial response work, and jointly safeguard the common historical memory of the Chinese nation and promote core socialist values.

If new situations or new problems arise during the implementation of this notice, please report them promptly to the Supreme People's Court level by level.

May 8, 2018
